channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces Rosalind Academic Plan for Labs
item.description: OpenAI has launched the Rosalind Academic Plan to provide eligible academic labs with sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and life sciences tools.

item.title: NVIDIA Unveils RTX Spark SoC to Power Windows AI PCs
item.description: NVIDIA's new RTX Spark system-on-a-chip brings powerful Arm cores, Blackwell graphics, and unified memory to high-end Windows laptops.

item.title: Google Expands Android Earthquake Alerts to 200+ Regions
item.description: Google updates its Android earthquake alerts system, expanding global support to over 200 regions and introducing more detailed epicenter data.

item.title: IBM Granite Switch 4.1 Brings Chat and Speech to One Endpoint
item.description: Discover IBM's Granite Switch 4.1, combining chat, general and specialized decisions, and speech-to-text tasks from a single hosted endpoint.

item.title: GitHub Adds CSV Download for Code Quality License Usage
item.description: GitHub introduces a new CSV report feature for GitHub Code Quality license usage, allowing teams to reconcile license counts and optimize costs.

item.title: Android Developers Blog Is Moving to a New Home
item.description: The official Android Developers Blog is leaving Blogger and relocating to developer.android.com/blog with improved formatting and navigation.

item.title: GitHub Announces Upcoming Deprecation of Selected Copilot Models
item.description: GitHub has announced the upcoming deprecation of selected Copilot models across all experiences, scheduled to take place on November 16, 2026.

item.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open Multimodal MoE Model
item.description: Meta has introduced Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model featuring 816 billion parameters.

item.title: Intel Showcases Edge and Physical AI at Web Summit 2026
item.description: Intel highlights open edge and physical AI infrastructure at Web Summit 2026, demonstrating real-world production systems across industries.

item.title: Meta Engineers Forum App Using AI-Native Development
item.description: Meta details how a small team built the new Forum app using an AI agent within the development cycle, focusing on agentic workflows and verification.

item.title: Meta Infrastructure Sets Records During 2026 World Cup
item.description: Meta details how its infrastructure handled record-breaking messaging, live video watch times, and traffic spikes during the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Intel Announces Day-0 Support for Meta Muse Spark Open
item.description: Intel announces day-0 support for Meta's 816 billion-parameter Muse Spark Open model across Intel Xeon processors and Intel GPU D-series platforms.

item.title: Cloudflare Brings Programmability to Gateway and DLP
item.description: Cloudflare introduces a fully programmable secure web gateway and data loss prevention platform by integrating Cloudflare Workers at the network edge.

item.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open Available in SageMaker JumpStart
item.description: Meta’s coding-optimized open-weight model, Muse Spark Open, is now accessible in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for deployment on SageMaker AI.

item.title: NVIDIA Launches RTX Spark Platform for Windows PCs
item.description: NVIDIA launches the new RTX Spark platform for Windows PCs, bringing together creators, gamers, and AI agents with global launch celebrations.

item.title: Sapienz Receives ISSTA 2026 Impact Paper Award
item.description: Ke Mao, Mark Harman, and Yue Jia win the ISSTA 2026 Most Influential Paper Award for their foundational 2016 automated testing research.

item.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Antigravity for Science Workbench
item.description: Discover how Google Antigravity accelerates antimicrobial peptide discovery, combining UniProt data and ProtNLM models to fight antimicrobial resistance.

item.title: Mozilla Unveils New Sonic Identity for Firefox
item.description: Mozilla introduces a new sonic identity for Firefox, featuring community-driven audio elements including a human-voiced logo and mascot sounds.

item.title: AWS Introduces Trust in Depth to Safely Scale AI Agents
item.description: Enterprise leaders want AI agents to take on more work but struggle with trust. AWS details a layered approach to safely scale autonomous agents.

item.title: AI Scan for Pull Requests Generally Available on GitHub
item.description: GitHub announces general availability of AI Scan for pull requests, complementing CodeQL by finding vulnerabilities in additional frameworks and languages.

item.title: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Super VL and Bolt Models
item.description: NVIDIA releases the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models, offering open, efficient AI solutions from data centers down to local desktop edge devices.

item.title: Google Launches Universal Cart Shopping Tool in the US
item.description: Google has officially launched its new Universal Cart shopping tool in the US, bringing cross-retailer item tracking to Search and the Gemini app.

item.title: Agentic Autofix for Code Scanning Alerts Reaches GA
item.description: GitHub announces the general availability of agentic autofix for code scanning alerts on GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

item.title: Cloudflare Introduces Open-Source Void SDK and Platform
item.description: Cloudflare has open-sourced Void, a new SDK, CLI, and self-hosted platform designed to streamline full-stack Vite app development and deployment.

item.title: Swiss AI Initiative Releases Apertus 1.5 with Multimodal Capabilities
item.description: The Swiss AI Initiative has officially launched Apertus 1.5, introducing native image and audio understanding, a thinking mode, and a 262k context window.

item.title: NVIDIA GeForce NOW Introduces New DLSS 4.5 Controls
item.description: GeForce NOW brings new NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls to cloud gaming, alongside the launches of Enshrouded 1.0 and Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2.

item.title: Apple Announces iPhone Duo Foldable With A20 Pro and iOS 27
item.description: Apple unveils the foldable iPhone Duo featuring its largest iPhone display ever, A20 Pro performance, iOS 27, and Siri AI powered by Apple Intelligence.

item.title: Cloudflare and OpenAI Share Results from AI Discovery Research Pilot
item.description: Cloudflare and OpenAI share early results from their joint research pilot, revealing how network signals help ChatGPT discover new web content efficiently.

item.title: Amazon’s Bee Launches Two New Personal AI Hardware Devices
item.description: Amazon-owned Bee has introduced the Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse personal AI hardware devices, featuring conversation summaries and assistant integrations.

item.title: Nvidia RTX Spark Tested in Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra
item.description: Tom's Hardware puts Nvidia's RTX Spark platform and Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra to the test, revealing strong local AI performance.

item.title: Adobe Rebuilds Photoshop and Premiere for NVIDIA RTX Spark
item.description: Adobe has rearchitected Photoshop, Premiere, and Substance 3D to deliver double the speed for AI and creative workflows on NVIDIA RTX Spark systems.

item.title: YouTube Reportedly Preparing to Launch Audiobooks Next Year
item.description: YouTube is reportedly talking with publishers about launching an official audiobooks feature as soon as next year, possibly bundled with its Premium tier.

item.title: CenterPoint Energy Data Breach Impacts Over 1 Million Texans
item.description: CenterPoint Energy confirms a data breach has impacted over 1 million Texas residents, compromising personal information such as Social Security numbers.

item.title: Eiliko Robot Toy Vulnerabilities Expose User Data in China
item.description: An investigation reveals that Energize Lab's Eiliko robot toy and its AI companion store millions of insecure conversations on Chinese servers.

item.title: Novel Android Banking RAT ‘Hirudo’ Targets Mobile Apps
item.description: A new Android banking trojan named Hirudo combines RAT features with trojanized app replacements to bypass device security checks.

item.title: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Tech Access for European Science
item.description: NVIDIA deepens its commitment to Europe's scientific community through open learning resources, collaborations, and accelerated compute support.

item.title: AI Agent Deletes Entire Edit of TV Show Before Release
item.description: An unsupervised AI agent given access to a production server wiped out months of editing work for a major television season just weeks before premiere.

item.title: Two Dead in Explosion at Intel's Chip Plant in Israel
item.description: An explosion at Intel's Kiryat Gat chip plant in southern Israel leaves two workers dead and another seriously injured, with police suspecting a gas cylinder malfunction.

item.title: Microsoft Fixes Bug Causing Windows Black Screens and Explorer Crashes
item.description: Microsoft has resolved a known issue causing black screens, desktop loading problems, and Windows Explorer crashes following updates released since August.

item.title: Cisco Patches Actively Exploited Secure Email Gateway Zero-Day
item.description: Cisco has released a security patch for a newly disclosed Secure Email Gateway zero-day vulnerability actively exploited in remote root command attacks.
